comment: Cash-flow forecast accuracy per client and target month (Apr-2024 to Sep-2026) for every scored horizon and model version: forecast vs actual inflows, absolute and signed error, absolute % error, P10-P90 interval hit and the within-10% flag. Model v1 scores the targets to May-2026 (MAPE ~18%), v2 from Jun-2026 (~11%) - the model-upgrade storyline. Only the 30D (one-month-ahead) horizon is backtested by the cash-flow engine; the 7D / 90D forward forecasts have no actuals yet. MAPE = AVG(abs_pct_error); Bias % = SUM(forecast_error_usd) / SUM(actual_inflow_usd); Interval Coverage = share of rows with is_within_p10_p90; Clients Within 10% MAPE = count distinct golden_client_id with is_within_10pct (per month) - errors are not additive, use these ratios. Grain: one row per golden client x target month x horizon x model version.
